lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Neck-to-riser fold of about 90.5 deg, between the outer skins of patches 1 and 4. The perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% put the label point 0.03, 0.05 and 0.24 mm from the outer-skin apex. The inner skin sits about 2.85 mm further along the bisector, so the label is on the OUTER skin. The line runs parallel to the fold. The visible fold runs t = -1.2..24.0 mm (about 25 mm including edge rounding) and the line covers 0..23.27 mm, so coverage is about 92%.
